summary: Useful extensions make authority temporary, couple each decision to durable rationale, and exercise the fence under realistic failure conditions.

items.text: Issue risk-adaptive capability leases that expire after one run, tool, resource scope, or time window; low-confidence and irreversible actions enter the escalation path.
Persist policy version, approval rationale, rejected alternatives, and outcome as a compact decision record so later audits can distinguish a justified exception from silent drift.
Run new agents in shadow or sandbox mode and promote privileges only after adversarial scenarios and repository checks pass; revoke the tier automatically after material configuration changes.
